title: Layout | Order food anywhere with AI
excerpt: Order food from any restaurant using AI. Layout lets Claude and ChatGPT place your real order, end to end.
content_html:
The food you want.
In the app you already have.

Agents can find the restaurant and pick your dish, then stop. Layout is the infrastructure that lets them transact.

Agents can find the restaurant and pick your dish, then stop. Layout is the infrastructure that lets them transact.

Compatible with

Compatible with

AI agents can find you food. We help them buy.

Layout is the infrastructure that let any consumer based AI assistant place a real order at a real restaurant. One card, every restaurant, every AI.

People are already asking AI to handle their food. The problem is it can't actually transact. Layout is the layer that turns a recommendation into a real order, automatically.

Layout learns what you actually order.

It remembers your go-to spots and usual orders, so your AI can reorder in seconds or suggest something new you'll like.

Layout learns what you actually order.

It remembers your go-to spots and usual orders, so your AI can reorder in seconds or suggest something new you'll like.

Does it work with every restaurant?

Pretty much, yes. We work with virtually every restaurant, and we are building direct contracts to make it even more seamless and totally free to users.

Do I have to sign in every time?

No. You sign up once through the connector and that is it. After that you just ask ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, or whatever AI you use to place an order and it does it. You will never even notice Layout is there.

Is my payment safe?

Yes. Your card is tokenized once and every order runs through a scoped one-time virtual card. Merchants never see your real card details.

Does it cost merchants anything?

No. Layout brings AI orders straight into a merchant's existing system at no cost and takes no cut.

Is Layout live yet?

We are early. Ordering is moving to AI agents and we are building the layer that makes it work across every restaurant.

Building a software? Ship ordering with Layout.

Layout is the transactional infrastructure for AI food ordering. One connection gets you real pickup orders at roughly 95% of U.S. restaurants that take online orders.
